result.title: MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety
result.summary: Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. To support training, we build an environment of 32 applications whose backends verify the effect of every action, supplying verified labels for supervision and rewards for reinforcement learning to calibrate intervention timing. We also build MobileVeto, an offline benchmark of unsafe trajectories largely on held-out applications, each paired with a benign counterpart. On MobileVeto, MobileGrail built on Qwen3.5-2B intercepts 76.2% of violations, up from 64.5% for its prompted backbone, while reducing premature intervention from 58.6% to 5.2%, outperforming the cloud-based OS-Sentinel on both. We further conduct online evaluation on GhostEIBench, where MobileGrail guarding a Qwen3.8-27B agent reduces fully successful attacks from 13 to 3 of 110 tasks while raising task completion from 48 to 58. Quantized to 4 bits, MobileGrail runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite at a median latency of 4.7 s, comparable to the 5.1s of cloud-hosted Gemini 3.8 Flash.

AI.brief_summary: 提出端侧可部署的移动 GUI agent 运行时安全护栏 MobileGrail：用一个循环任务状态只保留后续安全判断所依赖的证据，并区分 unsafe 与 block 两类标签以在干预窗口内提前阻断，配套可验证标签的 32 应用环境和离线基准 MobileVeto 进行训练与评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「循环状态仅保留决策所需证据」与干预窗口内的提前阻断，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、状态压缩和 STOP 时机决策相关；但该文面向安全护栏而非视觉推理，可供核查是否真有可迁移机制。
